description: Ouvrages de protection contre les inondations (OPI) is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l’Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs. Ce jeu de données contient de l'information sur les ouvrages de protection contre les inondations (OPI) répertoriées au Québec. Par exemple, il peut s’agir de digues en remblai de terre ou de murs de protection. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l’Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs. Its tags are Digue, Inondation, Mur de protection, OPI, Ouvrage de protection. It offers 6 resource(s) in ESRIREST, GEOJSON, HTML, PDF, WMS. The portal shows 2026-07-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
